description: Image A of the adopted two-image split (Lead D1/D4 decision, 2026-11-11): one pin-free host-drivable USER2 image carrying the runtime-decoded conv engine page and the FP32 GEMM page over a shared 64 KiB host memory window. This profile is SCAFFOLDING only: both page slaves are merged_page_stub placeholders and no build receipt exists yet. Image B (pooling corpus + EW) is a separate top/profile (fpga/ypcb_image_b_top.sv).

pages.name: conv_runtime_page
pages.status: S2 REAL page: CMAC GEMM job control + NVDLA CMAC DMA, driving the shared memory port as the third arbiter master

pages.name: gemm_page
pages.status: S2 REAL page: CMAC GEMM job control + NVDLA CMAC DMA, driving the shared memory port as the third arbiter master

s1_attach.gate: Do not replace the conv stub with the real page until conveng's parameterised C16 construction passes the hash-bound old-vs-new equivalence rerun (leg A primary 3/3 + leg B 51/51 controls + decoder 13/13 are pre-parameterisation PASS receipts; the parameterised rerun is staged for a Lead-scheduled window).

abi.register_layout: shared rk_job_control 12-bit-compatible page: 0x00 ID, 0x04 ABI, 0x08 STATUS, 0x0c COMMAND, 0x10 START_ADDRESS, 0x14 START_AMOUNT, 0x18 JOB_TAG, 0x1c RESULT_TAG, 0x20 RESULT_TASKS, 0x24 RESULT_CODE
abi.start_address: 16-byte aligned address inside the 64 KiB shared window
abi.start_amount: exact raw QWORD count (52 conv-simple, 54 vendor conv-fp16); fetched little-endian, unmodified, cmd_last on the last word only
abi.raw_arming: capture all START_AMOUNT QWORDs through the 16-bit memory port before asserting the first cmd_valid; cmd_ready may stall; no minimum rate
abi.rearm: pulse rst_n between jobs (decoder is one-job-locked: a second stream without reset is fault 7)
abi.status_mapping: completed_tasks = done && !error ? 1 : 0; error/error_code sticky until reset; acknowledged/frame_done are observation-only
abi.memory_owner: wrapper owns the shared memory master while fetching command QWORDs; core owns it from first cmd_valid until done|error; wrapper re-owns afterwards; tie mem_rsp_error=0 unless fault injection
abi.memory_aperture: the page's memory master must be able to reach the whole shared 64 KiB host window (operand/output BO addresses are inside the command stream)
abi.observations: leave the core's read-only observation ports unconnected (optional packed debug word reserved, not required)

s1_attach.synthesis_note: The runtime engine's explicit SDP-BRAM mapping and C16 construction are under `ifdef SYNTHESIS`; an Image-A build must define SYNTHESIS in the fileset verilog_define together with DESIGNWARE_NOEXIST (the D1 area receipt used {DESIGNWARE_NOEXIST SYNTHESIS}). The build template does this.
s1_attach.abi_reference_model: fpga/merged/merged_job_stub.sv implements the exact rk_job_control-compatible register ABI + a modeled submit->done lifecycle, so ABI/replay benches and negative controls are written and proven before the real page lands. It performs no memory access.

image_b.contents: pooling corpus pages + EW FP16/FDIV endpoint + ew-int
image_b.note: Separate top keeps the EW 1 MiB sparse memory aperture and the pooling pages; stub module merged_page_stub is reused. Image B has its own profile/renderer when its turn comes.

renderer.note: tools/merged/vivado_merged_image.py renders this profile. Required tokens: ROOT OUT PART TOP CONSTRAINTS CDC INCLUDE_DIRS READ_SOURCES SOURCE_SHA SOURCE_TAG PAGE_LIST PAGE_MASK PAGE_GATES. PAGE_GATES renders a REF_NAME-checked page-presence block so a stub cannot satisfy a real page slot.
renderer.source_tag: first 8 hex of the source manifest sha256, bound to BITSTREAM.CONFIG.USR_ACCESS

scope: Image A S1+S2: address map + page-presence + 3-master shared-memory arbitration + the REAL runtime conv page (raw-QWORD capture -> parameterised C16xK16 engine) and the REAL CMAC GEMM page. No synthesis, no bitstream, no hardware.
